lines.text: Sit. My knees are older than this road.
You should not be out here in the cold.
And you should not be standing there with a face like a closed shop.
They say the body freezes so you have time to finish the sentence.
The one you have been practising your whole life and never said out loud.
Then you are somewhere else, and we keep your chair.
You sit. She smells of betel and rain.
When you were small you counted the tiles to the crossing out loud. One. Two. Three.
I stopped at forty and lost count.
You always counted too fast. Here. Tea money.
Do not spend it on the fast lane. The fast lane is for people who have already arrived.
Go on then. And do not look back at the window.
Because I will be in it.
